# RKKP's Videncenter

RKKP's Videncenter is a Danish knowledge center referenced in connection with the ADHD-databasen, a national health database that monitors the quality of diagnostic assessment ("udredning") and treatment of ADHD in children and young people under the age of 18 [^src1]. According to its stated significance, the center administers the ADHD-databasen through Afdeling 3 (Department 3).

The corpus contains only a single mention of RKKP's Videncenter, on page 41 of the source document, with no accompanying relationships, claims, or timeline events. No further detail about its structure, staff, or activities beyond its role in administering the ADHD-databasen is available in the data provided.
